summary: This is a prospectus supplement (424B5) filed by Vertical Aerospace Ltd. to register and sell Series A convertible preferred shares to YA II PN, Ltd. under a Securities Purchase Agreement. The offering includes 25,000 initial preferred shares at $960 per share plus up to 7,559 PIK dividend shares and up to 54,446,488 ordinary shares upon conversion. There is no premium, board recommendation, or strategic event beyond a capital raise. The registrant is the issuer selling convertible preferred shares to a single investor. This is a routine shelf takedown under Rule 424(b)(5) for working capital, not a special situation.
